description: Figure 3 presents a bar chart illustrating the sample count for different essay genres within datasets categorized as either Open-Ended or Constrained. The horizontal axis displays the essay genre, labeled as “Argumentative,” “Narrative,” “Expository,” and “Open,” arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Sample Count,” employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 130, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Four bars are displayed, each representing a specific genre. The “Argumentative” bar is light blue and extends to approximately 79. The “Narrative” bar is a darker blue and reaches a value of approximately 80. The “Expository” bar is light blue and extends to approximately 68. Finally, the “Open” bar is a darker blue and reaches a value of approximately 110. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color differentiation, and no additional annotations are present.
